exposure: proximity to petrochemical industrial parks (PIPs) (prenatal and postnatal)
probability of PIPs exposure (prenatal and postnatal)
cohort: This study included a singleton birth cohort born between 2004 and 2017 in Taiwan.
finding: Proximity to petrochemical industrial parks and higher levels of benzene exposure, both prenatally and postnatally, were associated with an increased risk of childhood asthma.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was identified as a risk factor more prevalent in children with asthma.
